# QA repro fixtures

Megan's synthetic adversarial PDFs from the QA review of core 331a28a (`/workspace/qa/pdfcore/fixtures`, generated
there with pikepdf, reportlab, Pillow and piexif; no third-party or real user content), used by
`test/qa-repros.e2e.test.ts`. `LEAK-*` strings are canaries that must not appear in any output; the EXIF GPS values
(N 12°34'56.78", W 98°76'54.32") are made up. The same cases (regenerated copies) are in the core's `test/qa/fixtures`.

- `pdf-embedded-exif-jpeg.pdf`: JPEG image XObject (ASCII85+DCT) with EXIF incl. non-zero GPS, XMP, IPTC, COM
- `xobject-metadata.pdf`: image and form XObjects with `/Metadata` (XMP) and `/PieceInfo`
- `page-af.pdf`: page `/AF` with a Filespec / EmbeddedFile
- `page-privkeys.pdf`: JavaScript and Launch actions under private page keys and in `/Resources /Properties`

Large inputs (2000-page PDF, 6.2 GB object-stream bomb) are generated by the test. Test-only; not in the npm package.

Re-QA of core aea0eb0 (`/workspace/qa/pdfcore/fixtures/v2`), fixed in core 047da26, tests enabled:
- `privkeys-indirect-s.pdf`: Launch action whose `/S` and `/Type` are indirect objects
- `exif-indirect-subtype.pdf`: JPEG image XObject with an indirect `/Subtype` (EXIF/GPS kept by aea0eb0)

QA of core ea16ac5 (`/workspace/qa/pdfcore/fixtures/v3`), fixed in core 047da26, test enabled:
- `refchain-40.pdf`: 40-hop reference chain to a JPEG with EXIF/GPS and a `/S /Launch` dict via ExtGState `/BM`
